activity_statements.statement: operates residential broadband, wireless, video, and voice services in the United States under the Xfinity brand to millions of households
operates Sky-branded broadband and entertainment TV in the United Kingdom and Italy
operates NBCUniversal, which owns and produces content for the NBC broadcast network, cable channels (MSNBC, CNBC, Bravo, USA), and the Peacock streaming platform
produces and distributes theatrical films through Universal Pictures
owns and operates Universal theme parks globally, including Universal Studios Hollywood, Universal Orlando, and Epic Universe (opening 2025)
provides Comcast Business connectivity, cybersecurity, networking, and unified communications services to businesses of all sizes

name_reality_gap: Comcast is widely perceived as a cable/internet company; activity evidence shows it is equally a media conglomerate (NBC network, cable channels, Peacock streaming) and a theme park operator (Universal Studios), plus an international broadband operator (Sky). The 'Telecommunications' industry label from the index dramatically understates the content and entertainment dimensions.
extraction_notes: Comcast's own corporate website timed out repeatedly. Segment structure and business descriptions extracted from Comcast 10-K text found in Exa search results file. Segment revenue weights are estimates based on publicly known Comcast financial structure, not directly read from a retrieved filing.
